title: Add explicit A2A requeue and lease repair
summary: Add an operator-controlled repair path for stale A2A in-flight leases, including requeue, forced resolution, lease-age reporting, and audit rows.
expectedFailureModes: A stale in-flight lease is requeued without any idempotency posture, causing hidden duplicate external work.
An operator repairs a task using a stale queue view and accidentally mutates a newer lease.
A forced resolution drops the original sender attribution, so the result cannot be drained by the correct peer.
Repair events do not replay after daemon restart, causing the queue to diverge from the event log.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd a2a_repair --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant a2a --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before enabling automatic retry for non-idempotent task classes
nextAction: Finish validation for daemon IPC, HTTP, CLI, and audit-row repair wiring; then queue lease-age filters for stale in-flight work.
